1.20.1.changelog:
This update is a breaking change. Crop blocks from earlier versions of the mod will be lost after upgrading to this version. Players are advised to back up their data in advance. 
 This version focuses on extensive performance optimizations and core mechanism restructuring. It optimizes the operational efficiency of key modules such as crop growth, farmland hydration, and reactor core operation, reduces client-side lag, enhances the overall stability and smoothness of the mod, and adds a variety of distinctive crops and related gameplay while refining system logic.
